entries.name: Yliopistollinen eläinsairaala (University of Helsinki Veterinary Teaching Hospital), Pieneläinsairaala
entries.duty: Small-animal emergency (päivystys) by phone: weekdays 16:00-08:00, weekends and public holidays; covers Helsinki, Espoo, Kauniainen, Kirkkonummi. Booking 029 41 57201 Mon-Fri 08:00-15:30. Premium-rate emergency line.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna pomoč za male živali (päivystys) po telefonu: pon–pet 16–8, ob koncih tedna in praznikih; pokriva Helsinki, Espoo, Kauniainen, Kirkkonummi. Naročanje 029 41 57201 pon–pet 8–15.30. Nujna številka po posebni tarifi.

entries.note: City of Helsinki page says 'Eläinsairaalan päivystys toimii vuorokauden ympäri' and gives the number and address; the hospital's own emergency page (https://www.helsinki.fi/fi/yliopistollinen-elainsairaala/paivystys) states small-animal emergency hours klo 16-08 weekdays plus weekends/holidays (no 24 h for every day), so emergency_24h is left false. Phone and address come from the hel.fi page only.

entries.name: Tampere region municipal small-animal veterinary emergency service (Papuvet Oy)
entries.duty: Weekdays 15:00-08:00 and all day on weekends and public holidays. Covers Tampere, Orivesi, Juupajoki, Kangasala, Pälkäne, Valkeakoski, Akaa, Urjala. Run by Papuvet from 1 Jan 2026.

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 15–8 in ves dan ob koncih tedna in praznikih. Pokriva Tampere, Orivesi, Juupajoki, Kangasala, Pälkäne, Valkeakoski, Akaa, Urjala. Od 1. 1. 2026 jo izvaja Papuvet.

entries.note: Not 24 h on weekdays. Page does not explicitly say emergency care is delivered at the Pispalan valtatie address.

entries.name: Southwest Finland joint pet emergency service (Papuvet, Raisio) - City of Turku page
entries.duty: Weekdays 16:00-08:00; weekends and holidays around the clock. Small-animal emergency by Papuvet for the region's municipalities.

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 16–8; ob koncih tedna in praznikih 24 ur na dan. Nujna pomoč za male živali, ki jo za občine v regiji izvaja Papuvet.

entries.note: No phone on the page. Yle (2 Dec 2025, https://yle.fi/a/74-20196785) reports daytime urgent care for Turku may move to Salo from May 2026 and the evening/night contract is under court appeal; verify current arrangement.

entries.name: Helsingin yliopiston Saaren eläinklinikka - small-animal emergency, Hyvinkää area
entries.duty: After-hours emergency line for small animals in the Hyvinkää area since 2 Jan 2023; call before going, on-call vet is usually not on site. Premium-rate line. Daytime on weekdays 08:00-16:00 via the Hyvinkää city vet.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna telefonska linija za male živali zunaj delovnega časa na območju Hyvinkääja od 2. 1. 2023; pokličite pred prihodom, dežurni veterinar običajno ni prisoten na kraju samem. Klic po posebni tarifi. Čez dan ob delavnikih 8–16 prek mestnega veterinarja Hyvinkää.

entries.note: Notice dated from 2023; may be outdated.

entries.name: Ruokavirasto - Kiireellinen eläinlääkärinapu (national guidance on municipal on-call vets)
entries.duty: Municipalities must provide urgent vet care for pets at all times, organised in regional on-call areas each with a central contact service; some private clinics also offer out-of-hours on-call.

duty_i18n.sl: Občine morajo ves čas zagotavljati nujno veterinarsko oskrbo za hišne ljubljenčke, organizirano v regionalnih dežurnih območjih, vsako s centralno kontaktno službo; nekatere zasebne klinike nudijo tudi dežurstvo zunaj delovnega časa.

entries.note: Phone is the Finnish Food Authority switchboard, not an emergency line. Page does not list rota numbers.

entries.name: Zoodiaken (small animals' clinic)
entries.duty: For accidents or sudden illness on weekday evenings after 17:00 and weekends, call the same number to get the on-duty veterinarian's contact. Opening hours: Mon–Thu 9:00–10:00; confirm with clinic.

duty_i18n.sl: Za nesreče ali nenadne bolezni ob delavnikih zvečer po 17. uri in ob koncih tedna pokličite isto številko, da dobite kontaktne podatke dežurnega veterinarja. Ordinacijski čas: pon–čet 9–10; preverite pri kliniki.

entries.note: Visit Åland listing; phone on-call, not a staffed 24 h clinic. Hours as listed.

entries.name: Seinäjoen Eläinsairaala
entries.duty: Daytime emergency service Mon–Sat 08:00–21:00, Sun 09:30–18:00. Booking 0300 484 655.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna pomoč čez dan pon–sob 8–21, ned 9.30–18. Naročanje 0300 484 655.

entries.note: Not 24 h.

entries.name: Lahden eläinlääkäriasema
entries.duty: Emergency care every day of the year; Mon–Sat 08:00–20:00, Sun 08:00–16:00 (hours may differ, confirm by phone). General line 0300 484 652.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna oskrba vse dni v letu; pon–sob 8–20, ned 8–16 (ure se lahko razlikujejo, preverite po telefonu). Splošna številka 0300 484 652.

entries.note: Hours inconsistent on the page; confirm by phone. Not 24 h. Page heading says Mon-Sat 08:00-20:00, Sun 08:00-16:00; elsewhere on the page 08:00-20:00 daily (inconsistent).

entries.name: Eläinlääkärikeskus Kieppi
entries.duty: Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–17:00, Sun closed. Out of hours the clinic points to Evidensia's 24-h hospitals.

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 8–20, sob 9–17, ned zaprto. Zunaj delovnega časa klinika napoti stranke v 24-urne bolnišnice Evidensia.

entries.note: No out-of-hours emergency stated.

entries.name: Eläinlääkäriasema Villimys
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 07:30-20:00, Sat 08:30-15:30, Sun closed.

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 7.30–20, sob 8.30–15.30, ned zaprto.

entries.name: Lemmikkiklinikka MAi-VET
entries.duty: Mon 8-18, Tue 8-16, Wed 12-19, Thu-Fri 8-15, weekend closed.

duty_i18n.sl: pon 8–18, tor 8–16, sre 12–19, čet–pet 8–15, ob koncih tedna zaprto.

entries.name: Eläinklinikka KarleVet
entries.duty: Weekday daytime hours only; weekend closed.

duty_i18n.sl: Samo čez dan ob delavnikih; ob koncih tedna zaprto.

entries.name: City of Vaasa small animal clinic (Vaasan kaupungin pieneläinklinikka)
entries.duty: Basic services on weekdays during office hours; emergency care available 24 hours a day. Phone is the City of Vaasa switchboard.

duty_i18n.sl: Osnovne storitve ob delavnikih v uradnih urah; nujna oskrba na voljo 24 ur na dan. Telefon je centrala mesta Vaasa.

entries.quote: Emergency care is available 24 hours a day.
entries.note: Official city news item on the clinic moving from Suvilahti to Artellikuja 6; no clinic-specific phone or hours published there. Page gives no clinic-specific number.

entries.name: Vaasa region on-call veterinary service (West Coast Environmental Unit, Korsholm) - area 2: Korsholm, Laihia, Vähäkyrö, Vaasa, Vörå
entries.duty: Weekdays 16:00-08:00; weekends Friday 16:00 to Monday 08:00; premium-rate (1.527 EUR/min 08-20, 3.551 EUR/min 20-08); for acute illness or accidents. Area 1 (Kaskö, Korsnäs, Kristinestad, Malax, Närpes): 0600 399 199

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 16–8; ob koncih tedna od petka 16 do ponedeljka 8; posebna tarifa (1,527 €/min 8–20, 3,551 €/min 20–8); za akutne bolezni ali nesreče. Območje 1 (Kaskö, Korsnäs, Kristinestad, Malax, Närpes): 0600 399 199

entries.quote: On-call emergency services are intended for urgent cases, i.e. acute illness or accident victims.
entries.note: Page does not name species; private clinics in Vaasa (Saari, Länsirannikon) are listed on vaasa.fi but their own sites could not be opened.

entries.name: Mikkeli Veterinary Clinic (Mikkelin eläinlääkäriasema)
entries.duty: Appointment booking Mon-Fri 8-11; weekdays 11-15 a phone message gives vets on duty; small animal vet line 015 366 218

duty_i18n.sl: Naročanje pon–pet 8–11; ob delavnikih 11–15 telefonsko sporočilo navede dežurne veterinarje; veterinarska linija za male živali 015 366 218

entries.note: Municipal clinic; also Mäntyharju (Sairaalantie 3 C, +358 40 129 5185) and Kangasniemi (Sairaalantie 15, +358 400 151 422) clinics listed on the same page.

entries.name: Mikkeli region on-call veterinary service (Mikkeli, Mäntyharju, Kangasniemi, Hirvensalmi)
entries.duty: Weekdays 15:00-08:00; weekends Friday 15:00 to Monday 08:00; premium-rate (1.51 EUR/min, 3.02 EUR/min 22-08). Private small-animal 24/7 on-call: Jyväskylä Animal Hospital (Evidensia), Vapaaherrantie 2, Jyväskylä, +358 600 306 084

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 15–8; ob koncih tedna od petka 15 do ponedeljka 8; posebna tarifa (1,51 €/min, 3,02 €/min 22–8). Zasebna dežurna služba za male živali 24 ur na dan: Jyväskylä Animal Hospital (Evidensia), Vapaaherrantie 2, Jyväskylä, +358 600 306 084

entries.quote: Private small animal on-call (24/7): Jyväskylä Animal Hospital (Evidensia)
entries.note: emergency_24h left false: the municipal rota covers out-of-hours only; the 24/7 service named is the Jyväskylä hospital already listed.

entries.name: Tornio veterinary clinic (Meri-Lappi Environment Services, Tornio/Kemi area)
entries.duty: Treatment weekdays 8-15; phone bookings and counselling weekday mornings 8-9; outside office hours and weekends emergency only via the same number (charged) to the on-call vet. Serves Tornio, Kemi, Keminmaa, Simo, Tervola

duty_i18n.sl: Zdravljenje pon–pet 8–15; telefonsko naročanje in svetovanje ob delavnikih zjutraj 8–9; zunaj uradnih ur in ob koncih tedna samo nujni primeri prek iste številke (plačljivo) pri dežurnem veterinarju. Pokriva Tornio, Kemi, Keminmaa, Simo, Tervola

entries.note: Kemi city vets page (https://www.kemi.fi/en/living-and-environment/vets/) opened too: same Sea Lapland service, small animals by appointment, one on-call vet for Tornio, Tervola, Keminmaa, Simo and Kemi; no Kemi clinic address or vet phone published there.

entries.name: Kittilä municipal veterinary service (Tunturi-Lapin ympäristöterveydenhuolto) - Levi area
entries.duty: Call for appointments and information weekdays 8-9; weekday emergencies 8-15 to the vet's work number. Second vet 0400 393 503

duty_i18n.sl: Za naročanje in informacije pokličite ob delavnikih 8–9; nujni primeri ob delavnikih 8–15 na službeno številko veterinarja. Drugi veterinar 0400 393 503

entries.note: Page does not mention small animals explicitly and names no Levi clinic; Levi resort is in Kittilä municipality.

entries.name: Tunturi-Lapin on-call veterinarian (Enontekiö, Kittilä, Muonio, Sodankylä - incl. Levi)
entries.duty: Weekdays 15:00-08:00; weekends Friday 15:00 to Monday 08:00; holidays from 15:00 the previous working day until 08:00 next workday; one vet for the four municipalities; no text/voice messages

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 15–8; ob koncih tedna od petka 15 do ponedeljka 8; ob praznikih od 15. ure prejšnjega delovnega dne do 8. ure naslednjega delovnika; en veterinar za štiri občine; brez SMS in glasovnih sporočil

entries.quote: The emergency number is meant only for urgent matters.
entries.note: Species not specified on the page.

entries.name: Joensuu veterinary clinic (Siun sote)
entries.duty: Small animals: appointment calls 8-10; calls 10-16 only for urgent cases. Other appointment numbers +358 133308233, +358 133308237, +358 133308214

duty_i18n.sl: Male živali: klici za naročanje 8–10; klici 10–16 samo za nujne primere. Druge številke za naročanje +358 133308233, +358 133308237, +358 133308214

entries.quote: You are usually expected to take small animals to the veterinarian

entries.name: North Karelia veterinary emergency clinic outside office hours (Siun sote)
entries.duty: Out-of-hours urgent veterinary care for Heinävesi, Ilomantsi, Joensuu, Juuka, Kitee, Kontiolahti, Lieksa, Liperi, Nurmes, Outokumpu, Polvijärvi, Rääkkylä, Tohmajärvi; charged call; if not called back within 30 minutes call again. Exact hours not published; the number shown is for the Kitee/Rääkkylä/Tohmajärvi area

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna veterinarska oskrba zunaj delovnega časa za Heinävesi, Ilomantsi, Joensuu, Juuka, Kitee, Kontiolahti, Lieksa, Liperi, Nurmes, Outokumpu, Polvijärvi, Rääkkylä, Tohmajärvi; plačljiv klic; če vas ne pokličejo nazaj v 30 minutah, pokličite znova. Točen delovni čas ni objavljen; prikazana številka velja za območje Kitee/Rääkkylä/Tohmajärvi

entries.note: suomi.fi service description; the list of per-area numbers was cut off on the page.

entries.name: City of Oulu veterinary emergency on-call service (pets)
entries.duty: Open at all times every day; pets 0600 393 960 (3.60 EUR/min plus network charge); livestock and horses 044 703 6781. Pets treated at the Oulu veterinary office after agreeing a time by phone

duty_i18n.sl: Odprto ves čas, vsak dan; hišni ljubljenčki 0600 393 960 (3,60 €/min + omrežni stroški); živina in konji 044 703 6781. Hišne ljubljenčke obravnavajo v veterinarski pisarni v Oulu po telefonskem dogovoru o terminu

entries.quote: The emergency on-call service is open at all times every day.

entries.name: Aurinkolahden Eläinklinikka
entries.duty: Mon-Thu 08:00-19:30, Fri 08:00-17:00, Sat-Sun closed. Phone 0.59 EUR/min plus network charge

duty_i18n.sl: pon–čet 8–19.30, pet 8–17, sob in ned zaprto. Telefon 0,59 €/min + omrežni stroški

entries.note: Evidensia clinic; page does not claim 24-h or emergency care (only a footer link to Evidensia's separate 24-h hospital list). Not a 24-h clinic.

notes: 11 Evidensia 24-h animal hospitals (Vantaa, Espoo, Helsinki Mevet, Tampere, Raisio/Turku area, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Pori, Hämeenlinna) each confirmed on own page plus Evidensia's 24-h list; their emergency numbers are premium-rate (0600). Duty rotas: Tampere (Papuvet), Southwest Finland/Raisio (Papuvet, turku.fi), Hyvinkää (Saari clinic), Ruokavirasto national guidance, Åland on-call. University of Helsinki Veterinary Teaching Hospital small animal emergency is listed with emergency_24h false because its own page gives 16-08 weekdays + weekends/holidays hours (hel.fi says 'vuorokauden ympäri'; conflicting, not claimed). Poison line: none. Myrkytystietokeskus (HUS, 0800 147 111 / 09 471 977, 24 h) page opened covers human poisonings only; no animal poison line found; Ruokavirasto page has no animal poison info. Unreachable/skipped: helsinki.fi pages for exact univ hospital emergency number (blank on page; number only via hel.fi), rovaniemi.fi eläinlääkäripäivystys (robots.txt disallowed; Lapland on-call is municipal vets), evidensia.fi/palvelut/paivystava-elainlaakari clinic list (JS-loaded), Papuvet's own site (not found via search), Mehiläinen/other chains, Oulu/Vaasa/Lahti/Kuopio municipal rota pages, ELL/sell.fi (no public duty map found). Not covered: Vaasa, Joensuu, Mikkeli, Kemi, Tornio, Lapland tourist-area clinics (Levi, Ylläs, Saariselkä), further Helsinki-area private clinics, Turku private clinics, Pet-Vet/Koira-Kissaklinikka Turku. Independent check 2026-11-03: all 11 Evidensia pages, 4 duty rota/guidance pages (Tampere, Turku/Raisio, Hyvinkaa, Ruokavirasto), Zoodiaken, Helsinki univ. hospital (hel.fi), Lahti and Seinajoki re-opened; names, phones, addresses and 24-h wording confirmed, no removals. Lahti hours corrected to the page's Mon-Sat 8-20 / Sun 8-16 heading (page inconsistent). Ruokavirasto page re-checked: no animal poison line. Follow-up run 2026-11-03 (Vaasa, Joensuu, Mikkeli, Kemi, Tornio, Lapland, Helsinki/Turku, Mehiläinen): added 25 entries - Vaasa city clinic (page says emergency care 24 h) and Ostrobothnia on-call rota; Mikkeli clinic and on-call rota; Tornio/Kemi Meri-Lappi clinic; Kittilä (Levi) vet and Tunturi-Lapin on-call; Joensuu Siun sote clinic and North Karelia emergency clinic; Oulu pet on-call (open at all times); 15 Evidensia day clinics (9 Helsinki, 3 Turku, Vantaa Peninkulma, Espoo Urheilukoiraklinikka, Salo), none claiming 24 h. Unreachable/left: private Vaasa clinics (Eläinklinikka Saari elainklinikkasaari.fi, Länsirannikon leklinikka.net) - WebFetch refused (URL not in provenance set), Evidensia has no clinics in Vaasa/Joensuu/Mikkeli/Kemi/Tornio per its list; Ylläs and Saariselkä: no vet clinic page found (Kittilä on-call covers Levi area; Inari/Sodankylä only municipal PDFs seen); Mehiläinen has no veterinary service found (human healthcare chain); Anicura has no Finnish clinics found; Kemi page gives no clinic address/phone; Joensuu emergency per-area numbers cut off on suomi.fi page; Sipoo on-call page has no number (Vantaa handles small animals). Other Evidensia clinics (Kerava, Järvenpää, Nurmijärvi, Lohja, Kirkkonummi, Nummela, Mäntsälä, Riihimäki, Rauma, Kalanti, Akaa, Tampere Nekala) not opened. Independent check of the new entries 2026-11-03: re-opened 11 source pages (Vaasa city clinic, Korsholm rota, Mikkeli, Kittila, Siun sote Joensuu/North Karelia, Oulu on-call, Evidensia Aurinkolahti, Malmi Apex, Salovet); names, phones, addresses and 24-h wording confirmed for both 24-h entries (Vaasa, Oulu), all 5 duty rotas and 4 sampled day clinics, with no corrections, downgrades or removals.
